Pri (Partnerships): 🚀 Quick update: Fluxonomy closed a 2-year Dedicated commitment + ISV listing on the Google Cloud Marketplace. They've also asked for Redwood Private (VPC) for PCI workloads. Planning public launch next Wednesday morning.
Rafael (Sales): Amazing—congrats! Who's taking the customer quote and case study?
Mei (Marketing): I got the case study. Need: 1 short quote (<= 120 chars), 2-sentence customer profile, and high-res logo by EOD Tue to make the launch blog + social.
Anoop (Solutions): Infra notes: provisioned dedicated GPU pool in gcp-us-central1, pinned model `rwd-flan-13b-quant`, canary 10% -> 100% over 2hrs. KV cache priming scheduled at 00:30 UTC. Enabling audit logs to their KMS.
Dina (Finance): Contract countersigned—2yr committed ARR $820k. PO expected next week. Billing contact: accounts@fluxonomy.ai. Include premium SLA per SOW.
Pri (Partnerships): Fluxonomy legal approved a short quote: "Redwood gave us low-latency, compliant inference for payment workflows." They approved co-branded posts; brand kit in /partners/fluxonomy/brand.zip.
MarketBot: GCP Marketplace listing live: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/details/fluxonomy/redwood (id: gcp-0xD11). Propagation ~20-45 mins.
Mei (Marketing): Draft announcement uploaded: https://redwood.workplace/drafts/fluxonomy-launch.md. Requesting a 30-45s CTO soundbite; @Anoop can you coordinate recording?
Anoop (Solutions): Will schedule a 20-min tech interview and capture the 45s clip. Perf smoke test scheduled after KV warm; will post p50/p95 numbers here.
OnboardBot: Onboarding ticket ONB-9932 created; SRE runbook attached.
Rafael (Sales): Big shoutout to @Pri and @Anoop. Also looping CS for kickoff next Wed.
Mei (Marketing): I'll queue social for Wed 9am ET after indexing completes. Closing thread once marketplace indexing confirmed. :tada:
